content: Vaiming navy tah Sawcapaw alai vy
Cai a sei ciapaw leco Khazing tah a khuavang sahlo khah hmang he ka, khuahlai a ma pathlahtu sahlo hai lekhei uihlupui a phingphing khei bia a za rei tei.

Canghrasala atochai cai hning caipaw lehei co, a Sawcapaw hmang tah kaaning khatah bia a rei. Ama cawh zezong vytei ry cytu ruapaw tah thingpaw a cang. Ama thongtah alui le avai le zezong vytei heh tuapaw a cang.

Sawcapaw cawh Khazing rungnawnah khainah cang ka, Khazing cangnah a palangsahtu hmuisuipaw a cang. A bia thawtlungná tah zezong vytei khah a tlechui. Suanah vytei pathaisahnah a tua khy taitah vaicung letah Cungnungcai cacang lang letah a ty.
Macawtaco Khazing Sawcapaw cawh vaiming sahlo cypaw navy tah a rungnaw vypaw ming a cytu a cangpaw hratah vaiming sahlo navy tah a rungnaw vy sylypaw a cang.
Zemaw tah pawco Khazing tah a vaiming sahlo khah ahomaw,

content.text: “Nama cawh ka Sawcapaw cang ceh ka,
atoning heh na Paw ka cang myca,”
“Kama cawh a Paw cang neh ka,
Ama cawh ka Sawcapaw a cang a,”

content: Mataico, Khazing tah a sa-uthui khah khazaw letah a za thlaw ning tah,

content.text: “Khazing vaiming vytei tah beh he seh,”
“Ama taco a vaiming sahlo cawh thli tah tua he ka,
a raihretu sahlo cawh melui tah a tua he,”
“Vy Khazing, na buidyching cawh chaizaw tah chaizaw tai a hming a,
dingnah cawh na painah cungcahrei a cang a.
Dingnah cawh du ceh ka, chahlynah cawh na hua,
macawtaco Khazing, na Khazing tah alawngnah sathy ca thu ka,
na vesaw sahlo navy tah a ca pasang vy,”
“Vy Abuipaw, athoning tah Nama tah alui a pahnianah cawh tua ceh ka,
avai kheh na kih chuh a cang.
Ma sahlo cawh a rawh thlu he ka, canghrasala Nama cawh na hming paria a,
ma sahlo vytei cawh chaichi hratah a cai thlu he.
Taico angki pasuapaw hratah pabi he ceh ka, chaichi hratah a thlai thlu tae he.
Canghrasala Nama cawh chaizaw tah Nama ialia cang ceh ka,
na kungkhua zong chang thai beh,”

content: Canghrasala Khazing tah a vaiming sahlo khah ahomaw,

content.text: “Na caraepaw cawh na pherai letah
ka chiahlai vytei ka cacang lang hei a ty tua,”

content: Canghrasala vaiming sahlo cawh Khazing a raihretu longlong a cang he. Pachahnah a tingpaw cawngsaw sahlo bawkhang pawtah Khazing taitah tawpaw thlary a cang he.
